reviews.title: Everything at the airport was perfect until the actual plane flight. Also app does not work well.
reviews.text: You have more luck with checking in through the website then the app. App only allowed us to check in a couple family members on our fly out but eventually was able to get us all checked in after multiple tries from every single family member attempting to check in themselves and family members trying to check in everyone else. Finally we were able to get everyone checked in . On our way back, we could only get 3 of the 5 family members checked in. We had to wait till we got to the airport to actually check in. Airport was clean, super friendly people. We borded early which was fine but we didn’t have time to get out food before getting on the plane. We decided to order food while on the plane… they ran out of everything. No sandwiches, not even cup of noodles. The plane wasn’t even filled and there were people who did bring on some meals. Your only choices were cookies (that are gross), chips, nachos (sucked-not warmed, too much cheese a little chips), candy, or coffee. So make sure you bring it on food! Also if you like your drinks to be cold, they are served room temperature on the plane. Water bottles/coke cans/ etc will all be warm basically. No menus on the flight. You have to use the app. If you don’t have an iPhone, then you will not be able to open the app and see the menu.
reviews.author: Karina D

reviews.title: Worst airline experience ever
reviews.text: It's to long to detail all the ways this airline lied and ruined our vacation that we didn't end up going on due to this airline, avoid them for all reasons, terrible airline and even worse customer service. They will lie to you over and over and they are nearly impossible to reach for any assistance with issues, ended up trapped in the Tijuana airport due to Volaris lies and negligence.
reviews.author: Ron L

reviews.title: Flight
reviews.text: They stole makeup that I had in one of my bags and also $80 in coins I was taking to my country I don’t recommend this airline honestly
reviews.author: Camila

reviews.title: Worst airline ever, BEWARE!!
reviews.text: Terrible customer service! I could not check in online, tried about 5 times! So I figured I would get my boarding pass at the airport. My flight into Lax was delayed due to bad weather. I did not check my bag, went straight to the gate, they just barely started boarding,There was still 45 minutes left before the plane was supposed to leave, the attendant refused to print my boarding pass, said the flight was closed. I was stranded in LA at midnight!! I had to call a family member in the middle of the night to come pick me up. I tried to get another flight out for the next day and without looking at the computer she told me there was nothing available for the next 3 days!! I will NEVER book a flight with them again, I don't care how cheap they are!!
reviews.author: Irene L

reviews.title: Trash
reviews.text: Worst flight service in the LAX. Only airline to have their flights canceled. 3 flights back to back canceled and the attendant had the nerve to try and offer a reservation for 3 days later…
reviews.author: Carlos B

reviews.title: Made Us Miss Our Flight!
reviews.text: We got the ticket I would say two months before traveling. Everything went smoothly till we got to the airport. On the confirmation letter they told us to get there three hours before our flight. So we did, we had to fill out some paper work, then checked in (which they had trouble doing), then my cousin (16) made her way to the gate, mind you at this point the gate was still open, when she got to the door the police officer wouldn't let her in, telling her she needed a form signed saying she has permission to fly, and that he needed that form because she is a minor. So she had to run back to the front, tell them what the officer said, and they told her to go back and to tell him she doesn't need it. She she went back with the officer, and he told her the same thing, he would not let her board unless she had that paperwork. Okay so they made her back ! She told them again she needed that paper, and they finally gave it after a while!, meanwhile they would leave and come back, talk, and take their time. Once they gave her this paperwork, she ran back to the door, by the point she came back the gate had closed, and the police officer wouldn't let her go in, saying she was late and should have came earlier. She tried her best telling him that he saw her try to get in but they wouldn't let her. So at the end they made her miss her flight, and no refund, and the employees and company blamed it on her saying she should have came 4 hours earlier instead of 3, when in the confirmation is said 3 ! Highly Upset !
reviews.author: Katherin L

reviews.title: Do No Use This Airline - Extremely Racist Flight Crew
reviews.text: I will never use Volaris again. I traveled with Volaris May 26, 2023 and May 30, 2023. All flights and customer service was a nightmare. Our first flight was over one hour late which cause us to miss our connecting flight. The airline did not accommodate us or care. I purchased upgraded seats for my husband and I. We were not seated in the upgraded seats. We were scattered apart from each other. I asked the gate agent to please make sure we are seated in the upgraded seat that I paid for. I was laughed at by the rude gate agent and told that I was nothing that he could do. My husband was placed in the back of the plane I was in the middle. The flight crew was racist towards the African American people in the plane. I WILL NEVER TRAVEL WITH SUCH A DESPICABLE AIRLINE AGAIN. All flight attendants on our flight had their ID badge turned so that we could not notate their name to report to corporate. I have a photo of a flight attend that intentional removed her badge during flight so that her identity was not notated due to the rude and racist behavior. THE AIRLINE SHOULD IS A JOKE.
reviews.author: Lisa B

reviews.title: Worst Leg Room in the History
reviews.text: I never leave reviews, but I'm hopping that my message gets across and hopefully one day Volaris can do better. So far, I have travel in every single airline specially the cheap ones (frontier,spirit,viva aerobús, etc) Volaris definitely takes the cake for being the worst. Although they have a decent service, they have the worst leg space ever!! Unless you are 5’0 it will be impossible to have a comfortable Flight in Volaris. I seriously wish to see a change in the future but I doubt it because this Airline will put Profits>People’s comfort
reviews.author: Mario A

reviews.title: Save your money
reviews.text: Terrible treatment after my flight from Puerto Escondido to Cancun got cancelled. The options proposed by the airline included a flight leaving from an airport 100km away in less than 24 hours from the time I was informed about it, flying the next day or flying on the same day but arriving in Cancun at 11pm and literally being stranded at the airport late at night with no way of getting to my already booked accom in Tulum. I spent over an hour on the phone with an employee, who hung up on me after he told me he will transfer me to the supervisor. No possibility of reimbursement for any extra transportation/accom in Cancun for the night I had to pay for. Absolutely terrible customer service online and in person at the airport in Puerto Escondido. No willingness to even listen to me let alone help me. Will never fly with them again.
reviews.author: Unsatisfied customer

reviews.title: Terrible Service Buyer Beware
reviews.text: Booked tickets week in advance to Guatemala from LAX, for my wife, she flew too LAX to catch flight, when I'm trying to check in, its telling me my confirmation code is not valid, call customer service, I'm informed that they cancelled my reservation and can't give me a reason, although they have charged my credit card and charges are posted. Informed customer service and I use that term loosely, that I have a paid reservation, they don't care, and their was space on original flight but they won't book it because it leaves in 4 hours (and it will cost more than double) by the time she landed flight was sold out. They are not willing to do anything about it, but will sell me a ticket for next day for more than double the cost. No cancellation email, no reason, reservation cancelled just hours before trip, spoke to 3 agents 1 supervisor, absolutely terrible customer service. No help at all in resolving problem they created! I will never again book with volaris even if it was free. Cost me additional $700 dollars in last minute flight charges and hotel. Not so much as a sorry, or any other comments. Buyer Beware!! Now I have to fight with them for a refund.
reviews.author: BPak5

reviews.title: Nothing but problems and extra charges.  Will not use Volaris again, the "Spirit" airline of Mexico.
reviews.text: Purchased flight for two from TJ to Los Mochis for a wedding. Also purchased CBX tickets and rental car reservation all through Valaris' website. Itinerary, provided by Volaris, showed arrival time at CBX at 5:30am and flight leaving at 6:22am. Thought that was strange, but figured they knew what they were doing. Arrived at CBX at 5:20 and through the delays of 3 identity checks and lines on the Mexico side (who's trying to break into Mexico!), finally arrived at the Volaris desk at 5:55am and was told that they would not check my two bags and I would have to take another flight with extra charges of course. Next flight was on next day, so I asked to flight to Culiacan instead and was able to book later in the morning for and additional $150 dollars. My experience with US flights is that in the US the airlines generally bend over backwards to make sure passengers don't miss flights. Not Volaris in Mexico, they do their best to put up obstacles and excuses to charge passengers more. In addition to me missing my initial Volaris flight, a party of about 15 family members missed a Volaris flight at the same time as me and could be heard yelling at the Volaris personnel to no avail, they just don't really care. As my situation snowballed, I tried calling the car rental company to either cancel my reservation or transfer it to the new arrival airport in Culiacan. I was then informed that even though my reservation was with "Alamo", the Volaris website uses a third party company named "CarTrawler" to set up the reservation. As the CarTrawler paperwork directed, I tried calling the "font desk" several times, at least 5 times, but no answer or voicemail to leave a message. Long story short I had to pay for a second rental reservation at the Culican "Alamo" since they told me they had a different owner than Los Mochis airport and would not honor my reservation with "Alamo". CarTrawler" subsequently told me they would not give me a refund because it was my fault for not picking up the car initially. I could understand if I had to pay a penalty of one day, since they could rent the car after the first day of my missing it, but why the whole amount for 4 days? Thanks Volaris and CarTrawler. Lastly return flight with Volaris was a bit better, but they did charge almost $10 per passenger to print boarding passes since their Whatsapp was unable to print digital passes even with their personnel's guidance. The woman at the check-in desk has the audacity to ask me if the printing charge was ok. My response was "no it's not ok, but you're going to charge me anyway". After reading some reviews and with my experience, I see that Volaris is the Spirit of Mexico. I will not fly them again, since I believe in voting with my dollar. I'd rather pay a bit more and not deal with an unprofessional airline like Volaris. I hear Viva Airbus has better customer service, maybe I'll give them a try. If you decide to use Volaris, Good Luck!
reviews.author: Jess F

reviews.title: Don't buy your ticket thinking you can change it
reviews.text: Don't buy the business combo or flexibility or any of the options that allow you to change flight dates. They will make you call in to change the flight, and charge you the "difference" between an old ticket and a new ticket. this is more than the cost of a new ticket!! Customer service is basically like talking to a frustrating robot who have pre-scripted lines and are unable to deviate from the scripts. Its like talking to AI that doesn't really understand you and gives answers that don't inform you of the policies nor help solve a solution. You might save a couple bucks on the fare, but you will more than pay for it in time on the phone, customer service, delays and frustration.
reviews.author: James Z

reviews.title: Volaris - You're the worst airline ever
reviews.text: On the way to Mexico my son, his girlfriend, and her family took Volaris. This was a PM flight, and the pilot "forgot" to put their lights on while flying so other planes could see them. That was just the start. It was a 5 hour flight, and you had to pay for water. My sons girlfriend and her family have flown over 40 times. This is the first time they took Volaris, and will be the last. They all were petrified, and a couple of them were actually crying. 7 days later the day before they were to return, they couldn't find their tickets online. Well Volaris cancelled the flight and did not notify anyone by text, phone, or email. When my son was on the phone with Volaris, they were first saying that none of the group ordered tickets, but an email proved otherwise so there went that. Then Volaris said that the flight was cancelled, and everyone was notified. Yet out of all 5 people, not one received a cancellation of any kind from them. Volaris, instead of refunding them their money offered them each a flight voucher. However, they can not be used the same flight. So my son and his girlfriend couldn't use them on the same flight. BS They asked to speak to the Manager now, and after spending 8 hours just to figure it out everything out and calling back multiple times, it took up most of their last day in Mexico. Finally, Volaris agreed to a refund, but have to wait two weeks. So now my son, and the rest of the group had to cover their flight home, which took money from their spending money. They were all very lucky to find a flight with American. Volaris is supposed to be cheaper, well his American flight was only $50 more. You have lost all of us as further customers, and I hope everyone reads this and thinks about it before they take the flight.
reviews.author: Steph C

reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: I rate them 0 . They ripped my luggage and mixed all my personal belongings. I filled a report. They gave me a number to call , the call Goes to voicemail and one answers me . Never again will I fly with Volaris
reviews.author: Lesley G

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: The flight was cancelled for no reason without explanation. We are still waiting 5 hours for rebooking which can be days later. The airline is grossly understaffed. The customer service number is an answering machine that hangs up on you. Disgraceful. This airline should be fined. Pay extra and fly a respectable airline.
reviews.author: Tony F

reviews.title: no ser llevado al avión por funcionarios públicos.
reviews.text: I bought tickets on May 26, 2023, but I was not taken on the plane without any justification, my ticket was burned in vain and the money was meant and the money was meant to go to polaris, even though I scolded me and fired me in any way did not give my money back.
reviews.author: Musa Yenen

reviews.title: Airline only cares about making money and not providing good experience for clients
reviews.text: I traveled with my family and I have a special needs son who needs a wheelchair. They made me check in the wheelchair that was normal but didn’t want to provide a wheel chair to pick up my son’s wheelchair after our flight. I had to carry my son from one side of the airport to the other and when we got to baggage claim the wheelchair was not on there either. They made us get out of line and gave us the wheelchair almost heading out of the airport and since we got out of the line we were not able to pick up my vehicle at CBX. I was soooo mad because not only did I have a bad experience at the airport but now I was told I had to get Uber go through border patrol again and then get another Uber to CBX. Worst experience ever and I had to go through it with my two kids and one is special needs. If you can avoid traveling with this airline.
reviews.author: Guadalupe A

reviews.title: Worse airline, and even worse customer service along with Frontier.
reviews.text: I purchased my flight through volaris website where I paid for my checked bag. The day prior to my flight I tried to check but their website and and iOS app wasn't able to find my reservation. When I showed to frontier to drop off my bag they made me pay again for my check bag. I figure it was a simple miscommunication issue so I thought it would be solved easily. It has been almost three weeks now, Volaris terrible customer service takes ages to reply only to tell me that it was frontier fault, and frontier tells me that it was volaris fault. Is not a huge amount but what bugged me the most is that they want me to accept that they can't give refunds for bags and just suck it up. I'm still going back and fort
reviews.author: Gamaliel O

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE in Mexico.
reviews.text: I GIVE VOLARIS ZERO STARS!!! Volaris shamelessly steals customers’ money, worst service and very unprofessional staff.
reviews.author: Miguel P

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Volaris changed my flight to the next day , I had to contact them to cancel and to get a credit instead because I would not be able to take that alternative flight . The only option given was through WhatsApp ! I started the conversation at 1:00 pm and it would take them anywhere from 2-3 hours to respond back asking for additional information , I would reply back and another 2-3 hours would go by . Finally at 3:00 am I had a full response , 14 hours later ! I stayed up all night because I had to agree with the conditions and terms in order to proceed with the cancelation . Once it was credited I noticed there was an error with the credits . So I had to start another conversation because when I replied back to that same message thread the agent had already closed the conversation (within a minute from their response). The new conversation started at 3:00 am and I did not get a full response until 8:34 am . Unbelievable, I will never book another flight with Volaris that is for sure , customer service is ridiculous .
reviews.author: Neyra

reviews.title: This airline is getting worst and worst
reviews.text: First of all their customer service is trash. I spent a good amount of time trying to speak with an agent only for them to hang up on me when they answered. Their WhatsApp customer service is a scam they said my fathers flight included a carry on only to pay extra at the airport because it was not included. They also changed my flight and was told I would received 25% back for the inconvenience. Well haven’t heard a thing about that, still waiting. My luggage was damaged upon arrival the handle was torn off and of course they won’t do anything about it. Very disappointed will be swinging airlines.
reviews.author: Cristina Z

reviews.title: Rude Agents and Careless Baggage Handling
reviews.text: Paid the baggage fee for a Bicycle to be checked onto the plane only to be charged more when I checked in and then to have the bike box crushed and left in T.J. - Was in town for an Ironman event and finally got the bike delivered to me at 2am and it was inoperable. I filed a claim and I followed up with them when I returned. They asked me for an estimate which I provided and now nobody will return my calls...just perfect.
reviews.author: Greg R

reviews.title: Customer service nightmare
reviews.text: Unwilling to change itinerary not even acting to care. Chatbots on Facebook and whatsapp designed to keep you in loop forever with no chance to have things resolved properly. Customer service agent applying the same technique - letting me fade out in the loop after telling me to 'redirect' me.
reviews.author: teftliefel

reviews.title: Volaris stole my money. They do not answer me now.
reviews.text: Their strategy overselling the flights. Then, from there there are tons of excuses to not give you the money back. After 3 months , I never got the money back and a nobody care after you give them your money. They oversold my flight to CMDX. For that I lost the International flight. I lost the money for both. I created multiple tickets and after few hours they usually close them. Please Never, Never buy with Volaris. Full of bad surprises.
reviews.author: Cesar G

reviews.title: worst airline
reviews.text: Terrible airline, I only booked because it was a direct flight from CDMX to Sacramento CA. But I will never fly again Volaris. When you book your ticket you enter your first, middle, and last name. Well the company took my middle name and changed it to be my last name so of course it did not match my passport as my middle name is different from my last name. During the check in process (24 hrs before my flight) I noticed this and called the customer service number and they informed me that I am unable process this change due to this being 24 hrs after I purchased my ticket. I am well versed in how to book and purchase flights using my middle name and last name. Volaris has a problem in their web site on middle names. I put up a fight and asked them to cancel my entire trip since I wouldn't be able to board due to their site having an issue with the correct name. They transferred me to manager who assured me that he could change the name but there would be an additional charge. I agreed to the extra charge and waited ten minutes on hold for them t process my payment. I have confirmation when I purchased my ticket and my name was correctly spelled first middle initial and last name. Again, this airline is corrupt and charges for even the air you breath. If you can avoid them at all costs, do not fly a corrupt airline. This will be the second and last time I fly Volaris. Also I paid for a seat upgrade (first row) and it was as if I was sitting on a wooden board for a 4 hour flight. Terrible experience, terrible customer service. Worst Airline.
reviews.author: Ryan B

reviews.title: Volaris is a corrupt and crooked airline
reviews.text: Traveling from OAK to Leon Mexico for a wedding . Volaris cancelled both my outbound and return flight . And rebooked it for 2 days later . Scrambling to find out what I was going to do , I had to change the return flight to LAX , Volaris charged me $600 for this ! Absolutely ridiculous . Horrible airline with horrible customer service . Will never fly this airline again .
reviews.author: John E

reviews.title: WORST MEXICAN AIRLINE
reviews.text: I booked one month ago my round flight from Guanajuato to Tijuana. Yesterday I received a mail mentioning that my flight to TIJ was canceled. In the call center OF COURSE they couldn´t fix the situation, since I booked from one specific day to another. They say they have the "responsability" of taking me to my destination, but in the time and day they want, not the one I payed for. I am now canceling all the trip since the days they want me to flight, are not working for me, but of course they are not going to pay for reservations made. They ofered me 25% of compensation in a voucher that you need to use with them to have the oportunity to SCAM you again. In this point I do not even expect to receive it, I just hope to have my money back (in a period of 7 to 21 days as per their policy) Guys really, if you don't your trip to be screw, do not use Volaris. This is the worst mexican airline for a reason (FY Volaris!)
reviews.author: EdmundoV576

reviews.title: Terrible!!
reviews.text: Yesterday we were supposed to fly back to LAX (they ended up canceling our flight) They told us our suitcases were “too big” we took a measuring tape when we bought them and it was the size that the Website was telling us. Apparently they measure in cm here but that information was no where to be seen online. They made us pay extra money just for that. They charge money for every little thing because that’s all they care about. The Money!! Volaris is just a scam. They have poor customer service and very rude employees aswell…
reviews.author: Brianna

reviews.title: E-Credit
reviews.text: What a terrible airline you think you have a credit for a flight, but they don't have direct flights to anywhere! Only a red eye or long lay over. There are charges after you book whether you used all the credit or not SCAM !!!! WORSE AIRLINE EVER! IF YOU DON'T USED THE E-CREDIT YOU LOSE IT
reviews.author: Monica D

reviews.title: SCAM !!   PERIOD
reviews.text: YA VAS + VOLARIS = ANOTHER WAY TO SCAM!!! DO NOT USE THEIR YA VAS SITE, they are scamming people with the old BAIT AND SWITCH, I went into their web page YA VAS to book a flight/hotel package, after reading their rule and cancellation policy decide to make the booking, I chose the Hotel and the flight according to my needs, a flight departing from Ontario, Ca to Guadalajara, Mex, the time chosen was to depart at 00:47 on sat May 6th arriving the same day at 4:47 am,( need to be there for Saturday event) returning on May 8th, I do travel frequent and I know better to make sure to select the correct flight!, So I triple check the correct flight was selected with my wife sitting next to me and took a picture of the selected itinerary, so after clicking yes to the payment I received the confirmation, I noticed right away that the outgoing flight was CHANGED to a different time !!!! The Departure time we were assigned now was to depart at 19:30 pm arriving at 23;30 on May 6th. I call right away Volaris and spoke to a rude guy name Alex, he said there is nothing we can do, you have to pay and upgrade, without even looking into it, he said he was going to finf out how much and after 15 minutes he just hung up on me, I called back and this time spoke to a girl name Carol, and she told me to call back in the morning because the department was close, I decided to write an email to explain the situation and to try and fix the issue, (to this day I still haven't received a reply) Next day I called as soon as they opened ( 8am Mexico city central time) and spoke to a girl Lidia Gutierrez, she told me that I needed to call a different department and that they didn't open until 9am. I called back again and spoke to this other very rude and condescending girl name Yana Robles, she straight out said no, that I made the mistake and even if it was a system error, I had to pay ANOTHER $335 in order to change the flight to my original selected flight time, because I made the reservation on their system and I didn't speak with an agent!!?? I told her that I felt that was not fair, and I ask her to please speak to a supervisor or someone else that could help me figure out a better way to solve the problem, her answer " there is not supervisors'', I asked when or what time can a call back to reach one and she said there is not date or specific times, bottom line that was it! I tried trying to get in contact or information via their live chat and another rude and condescending agent name Ignacio gave me the same treatment, basically starting the chat with "there is already a documentation that you have already contacted us" again blaming me and saying I need to pay and after that he just ended the chat!! I had problems with them before. I never intended to fly again with them, but after many years decided to give them another try..... NEVER AGAIN!!!!

I paid $482 for 4 checked in luggage that should be against the law. I for sure will be vigilant next time and choose my Arline carriers carefully next time.

The supervisor, a woman named Marisol, was very rude and didn't know her own company's policies. Avoid this airline like it's your worst fear.

Volaris booked and Frontier was carrier.Volaris sent email confirmation with code. I could not use confirmation code on Volaris or Frontier site 3. Pay an assist charge, then Frontier finally issued by boarding pass. Never Again will I use Volaris , Vamos

reviews.text: Do not ever use this airline!!! They are thieves!! liars!!! terrible service!!! They do not care about the client!!

reviews.title: Ice cold planes most uncomfortable seats in the world.
reviews.text: If you ask them why they will tell you it is 40° because it is night time. A further search on Google revealed that they don't want you to get hypoxia but really that is extremely cold and uncomfortable. The seats are narrow and the cushions are non-existent it's like sitting on a sheet of metal ice cold metal. They charge you even for water which adds insult to injury. Better to pay more or go through another airline rather than sit through four to five hours of complete torture. I want to mention that I am a fit man physically I weigh 160 pounds I believe if I can be uncomfortable in these a normal person eating a normal diet couldn't possibly even fit.
reviews.author: Ernie R

reviews.title: Flight overbooked - could not care less!
reviews.text: We had booked a flight with Volaris, guaranteed at the time of booking. Online checkin did not work. We arrived at the airport early, but were only told that they had overbooked the flight and we were not on it. "All airlines do this". After a long wait we were offered tickets 7 hours later: problems with rental car resulted, plus we had a very expensive hotel booked and lost the entire day. No apology, no help, no food, none of what they promise as passenger guarantees on their website was offered. A day at a noisy crowded airport instead of a private Cenote. And the ticket had not even been cheap.
reviews.author: MALO

reviews.title: Gabo A.
reviews.text: The airline charged me $94.99 U.S dollars for an extra back pack . I traveled from U. S on April 2 with same two back packs and no charge . I paid extra for the 3rd and second roll seat each way . So I had extra leg room . But they said I had to pay for it extra . I wish they tell people no matter if you fly in premium class . I have booked an extra fly and paid . However after that no plans in the future to fly w them . ETHICS , ETHICS. NOT RECOMMENDED HONESTLY .
reviews.author: Gabo A

reviews.title: A New Low: Surprise Stops
reviews.text: Volaris is not a trustworthy airline. They lie at every turn. We booked a nonstop flight from Costa Rica to Los Angeles. After we boarded, we learned that there was a stop in Guatemala. They themselves couldn’t explain it except to shrug. At Guatemala they made us exit the plane with all our bags and go through security just to get back on. Before we checked in, we were told unequivocally there would be WiFi. Lie. The in flight options for food and drink were impossible to bear. Staff was rude and contradicted each other often. All in all, with over 100 flights under my belt, this was by far the worst experience. I will never fly this airline again. I strongly suggest you pay the additional fare and get something more reliable; I will moving forward.
reviews.author: David B

reviews.title: Overall not-so-bad experience
reviews.text: I was hesitant at first to fly Volaris due to the bad reviews and notices of cancellations or delays. My family and I used CBX from San Diego to Tijuana airport. We then flew to Oaxaca and then used Volaris on the way back as well. Overall, no problems. We paid an extra $10 for the premium seats for the extra legroom and it was definitely worth it. The staff was friendly, gave great snack options, no big issues. The slightest issue was the slight (maybe 20 min delay) on the return flight so the plane wasn't cleaned very well - there were some crumbs on my seat when I boarded. Overall, not a bad experience.
reviews.author: Arianna C

reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE KNOWN TO MAN!!!!!
reviews.text: I have literally never flown a worse airline!! I flew Volaris a year ago to visit my parents who live in Mexico and had a terrible experience. I thought it must have been a fluke and decided to give them another chance. I will write about both experiences below, but for those looking for a quick read, I WOULD LITERALLY RATHER SPEND THE NIGHT AND HAVE A LAYOVER THAN FLY THIS AIRLINE AGAIN!!!! LITERALLY TERRIBLE!!!! Last year, I arrived to the airport, only to find out they had cancelled my flight without any notice. I wasn't able to fly out until A WEEK later!!!! They offered no apology, no money, no voucher. NOTHING!!! AND THEY WERE INCREDIBLY RUDE!! Then, this year, they lost my bag. I have been without my luggage for 8 days and no one has contacted me. I have tried to call them 4 times and been "talking" with them on whatsapp since I landed on April 14th. Literally not one single ounce of help. My bag is clearly gone forever. If you want to be stranded in mexico without your bags, fly this airline. Otherwise, I highly recommend flying something else. Even if you have to stay the night in another city!!!! Don't do it!!! They SUCK!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: Sarah B

reviews.title: Safe flight but stuff got stolen out of suitcase
reviews.text: Convenient and cheap flight .. but I was so sad to get my bag from baggage claim and see all zippers were open and my sunglasses were stolen out of front pocket . Pack smart and you should be fine but I’m definitely going to think twice before flying them again.. They also charge $60 for a checked bag And $150 pesos for each boarding pass if you don’t have app
reviews.author: Ellie L

reviews.title: Incompetent staff
reviews.text: On August 7th, I arrived at San Jose Airport to take my flight (Q64054). Having lost my kid's passport at the week before, the only document I had to fly him back to Spain was an official give away pass from the French embassy in Costa Rica (We are French and decided to land in Spain and then drive back to France). The French embassy warned us that this pass was valid anywhere except if transiting through the USA (they do not accept it). When check in came, we were denied to board and fly. The lady said this pass was not accepted by the Mexican immigration (We were transiting : San Jose - Cancun Cancun - Barcelone). As it was on a Sunday, we could not get ahold of the French embassy that day to help us get on board. The Volaris staff manager was pretty agressive and would not want to hear anything from us. We gave up and lost a 1100€ flight back to Europe. We found out the next day that this had been a mistake from that lady who had the wrong information : our pass was indeed valid to transit through Cancun. I am now fighting to get my money back, still 8 months later. Where is my money????
reviews.author: Hubert Martin Taton

reviews.title: Robbed of 400 dollars
reviews.text: We were robbed of 400 dollars by negligent employees. At LAX We had three cabin bags that passed fine, we were allowed to take them on the flight even though they were a bit large, but it was assumed that they were okay because we werent told anything upon departure. On our flight back, we were told that they were actually too big and we had to pay to take them on the flight. They charged us 1600 pesos per bag. which for three bags came out to around 400 dollars. My son was the only one with a debit card on him so he was forced to pay it all out of pocket as we only had a few pesos left. when we asked what could be done about our bags if we were unable to pay they gave yus no answer. "we do not know what will happen with your bags if you leave them" they said. Robbery either way. This could happen to anyone. Please never use this airline even if you are strapped for cash. You will end up losing any money you could have saved anyway when they find a way to take your money.
reviews.author: Pedro Lozano

reviews.title: Worst Airline Ever
reviews.text: Volaris airlines is the worst. They are unreliable and have no concern or respect for their passengers. All employees are extremely young and don’t seem to have much training. Their planes are old, and unreliable. They have no entertainment systems, wifi, or device charging outlets. We had booked tickets on flight 4084 from Costa Rica to JFK on 04/15/23. We picked Volaris because they were least expensive. That was a big mistake. We had purchased tickets advertised as non-stop from Costa Rica to JFK. Instead they made a stop in El Salvador, then flew to New York but turned around over Florida and flew back to Cancun. At Cancun we were de-planed on the tarmack and forced to board another plane. We were then flown back to El Salvador. The crew would not provide any info. First it was bad weather in New York, then it was mechanical problems on our plane. We never found out. We were promised meals and a hotel in El Salvador. They did serve us some stale bologna sandwiches and cans of soda. There were no hotel rooms available for us so we had to sleep on the floor of the airport. The next morning we boarded anothed plane and were flown to our orginal destination. We finally reached New York 24 hours after leaving Costa Rica. After repeated complaints from many passengers about the long delays, lack of communication and generally terrible treatment, we were offered $150.00 Volaris vouchers that woukd be valid for 30 days. We refused the vouchers because we would never want to fly with Volaris again. Here are pictures of the line for Bologna sandwiches in El Salvador as well as my daughter getting ready to sleep on the floor of the airplort,
reviews.author: rod54

reviews.title: EVEN IF THIS IS THE ONLY FLIGHT YOU CAN AFFORD DO NOT TAKE IT!!!
reviews.text: Hello I’m a college student and don’t have much money and had to go to Mexico for my cousins wedding. I did as any broke college student would do and looked for the cheapest flight. Behold I found Volaris. This was when the problems began. I booked my flight which had 6 hours of layover both way (which is okay for how cheap it was) but after a week I had purchased the flight they decided to change my flight to 3 days later even thought I had booked for a certain day. I was mad but decided to try to fix it so I called and called and called at least 1000 times till someone answered and each time I called I was on hold for over an hour. I finally get ahold of customer service who were very rude and clearly didn’t care and on top of that didn’t speak any English so it was almost impossible to understand what they are saying. I explained the issue and the changed my departure flight which was great. I hung up and the next day they changed my return flight to 5 days later than originally purchased, what am I gonna do in Mexico for 5 extra days? So here we go again I call and call and call and wait on hold for over 8 hours and finally I get someone. Only to find out they were worse than the first perosn I spoke to. They tried to charge me double what I originally paid to change my flight and I couldn’t afford it. Finally I demanded a refund after hours of talking to how they changed it and I have the right to change flights as it says on their website and scrapped together enough money to fly on a different airline. DO NOT EVER FLY YOU WILL HAVE PROBLEMS. They did the same exact thing with my girlfriend and other friend who were all going to Mexico along with me.
reviews.author: Victor M

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: Arrived on time for my flight, then it got delayed Which made me loose my connecting flight To my destination They rebooked my flight two days later and only helped pay for one night and I had to figuere out where to stay the next night.Extremely rude supervisor at Volaris. I cannot believe how bad this airline is, will never fly with them again. I know that whoever is reading this will probably even book it because of the prices but it’s not worth it, there are a total nightmare.
reviews.author: Yuki M

reviews.title: Staff treated me poorly once he knew I was American
reviews.text: The day prior to my flight I tried checking in, but the app and the website kept popping up error notices. This happened to 4 of my other friends I was traveling with. On the day of our flight, we waited in line (with upwards of 100 people likely because the Volaris app was down). The staff member at the counter was incredibly rude and condescending to me as soon as I handed him my passport. I stated that I just needed to check in and obtain a boarding pass. He replied that I owed money for a boarding pass. I pulled up my payment information for the flight on my phone to show him that I had already paid in full and that the charge was approved the day I bought the flight months prior. He said it was for “another charge” but wouldn’t specify for what. At the same time, my friends were checking in at the same counter for the same flight with another Volaris representative. She checked in all 4 of them and provided them with their boarding passes without any issue. They were all done before me, and then came to me once they were finished. The representative I spoke with kept insisting I pay “another fee” and I refused as I had paid everything in full and had it in writing through the Volaris app. We went back in forth in English and Spanish. Because I refused to pay for “another charge” he kept trying to make me move to the side to assist another customer. I was so upset and disgusted by the way he was treating me. I felt it in my bones that he was being difficult and dismissive because I’m Latina who happens to be an American too. For anyone who doesn’t know, this is a thing in the Hispanic community. I refused to move aside as I still needed to check in and obtain a boarding pass. He kept saying that I should’ve checked in online, which I repeatedly explained that I couldn’t as the Volaris app and website were down. I even took screenshots the day prior and tried showing them to him, but he said he didn’t want to see them, he wanted to see the website or app actually state what I was saying instead - as if I was lying to the guy. Finally, after my male friend came up behind me and sternly stated twice, “She already paid in full as stated in the app. She just needs to check in and a boarding pass” the guy typed something into his computer and printed a boarding pass for me. He did it in less than a minute. Had he done this at the beginning of our encounter, perhaps I’d be a happier customer and there wouldn’t be the longest line ever at the Volaris counter. People like this representative should not work in this field. This was the worst experience I’ve ever had with an airline. I’m never flying with Volaris again. Do yourself a favor and fly with another airline! I’ve heard Aeromexico is more expensive, but still might be a better option.
reviews.author: Kelly O.

reviews.title: Worst managed airline
reviews.text: Online reservation is crap. When you can’t finalize luggage checkin they charge $174 per bag at gate and treat you like an idiot. Then when you get mad they send you for a narco pat down and go through your luggage. I have traveled the world for 40 years and never had this experience.
reviews.author: Paul R

reviews.title: Volaris Baggage and Cancelation Issues
reviews.text: One of the worst airline experiences I have ever faced out of many trips. To begin, they offer many special flight deals and then once you think you have a great deal on your flight the extra not fees per say but you have to pay for extra cost like seats which should be included in the ticket like every other airline. Secondly, luggage is overpriced compared to other airlines and to make it worse they changed my flight when my hotel was already booked with the flight and due to the change my departure was delayed 1 day (not even a few hours... ONE DAY WAS LOST), causing me to have to pay an extra day for my hotel. Finally, the main reason I will not be flying with this airline anymore. When I was checking in my bags for my departure back home, keeping in mind they were not over the weight limit, they suddenly decide to tell me that one of my luggage was exceeding the dimensions which is nonsense because it was the exact same luggage I checked in when I departured to my destination, and in the end I had to pay an extra $80 due to my luggage being "to big". Their justification for this was that different airports have different dimensions, however I used Volaris in different cities in Mexico with the same luggage and I was never charged or even questioned about my luggage dimensions. Again ridiculous, since every international Volaris flight should have the same dimensions, and there was never a mention about the dimensions differing in other countries. So if you're trying to save money you're better off with better airlines that include 3 times more than Volaris at similar prices.
reviews.author: Teresa M

reviews.title: Terrible service and utter disregard for passenger hospitality
reviews.text: Volaris flew from San Salvador on the way to newark nj and stopped at Cancun on 4/15/2023 4pm flight. They made us stay in the airplane for hours, then flew back to San Salvador. At the airport, they did not give us hotel, nor food, much less an explanation for flight cancellation. They told us that the hotel was for people 70 and older. They had the guts to sell us a nasty sandwich which was even getting rotten. We had to sleep on the floor like animals. This airlines in on the top 10 worst Airlines in the world. We will never use them again
reviews.author: Everth
